description: What TikTok lets a TikTok account post right now: the audiences it offers, interactions the creator has switched off, and the longest video. A direct post needs a person to pick one of these audiences in its approval card; there is no default. Until TikTok's audit (audited false) the account itself must also be set to private in TikTok at posting time, or TikTok refuses with TIKTOK_ACCOUNT_NOT_PRIVATE.
name: tiktok_creator_info
title: TikTok posting options
